purpose: Provide a CPU reference timing surface for the existing GPU scaling gate without claiming identical multi-state CPU semantics.
preconditions: tlul_slice_host_probe is built from the README flow

allowed_claims: GPU batched throughput from the existing scaling report
rough order-of-magnitude comparison clearly labeled as non-equivalent workload
non_claims: no exact CPU-vs-GPU speedup claim for nstates > 1 until a CPU loop with matching state count is implemented
no target-breadth claim because only tlul_fifo_sync is exercised
